summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests navlimetostat given together with pumitamig in adults with MTAP-deficient advanced non-small cell lung cancer. Navlimetostat is taken by mouth once daily, and pumitamig is given by IV infusion every 3 weeks in 21-day cycles until disease progression or the treatment is not tolerated. The goal is to find a safe and tolerable dose, and the study will also look at how well the drugs work; a specific primary outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa navlimetostat administrado junto con pumitamig en adultos con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas avanzado y deficiencia de MTAP. Navlimetostat se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y pumitamig se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 3 semanas, en ciclos de 21 días, hasta la progresión de la enfermedad o hasta que el tratamiento no se tolere. El objetivo es encontrar una dosis segura y tolerable, y el estudio también evaluará qué tan bien funcionan los medicamentos; no se indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Advanced non-small cell lung cancer confirmed by tissue or cell testing.
MTAP loss shown by homozygous deletion or absent MTAP protein expression.
Prior systemic therapy for advanced disease and at least one measurable lesion.
not_for: Prior treatment with PRMT5 or MAT2A inhibitors.
Prior treatment with anti-PD-1/VEGF or anti-PD-L1/VEGF bispecific antibodies.
Systemic anticancer therapy within 21 days or 5 half-lives before enrollment.
Significant risk of lung bleeding, or recent intracranial, spinal or GI bleeding within 3 months.
Uncontrolled hypertension, poorly controlled diabetes, or average QTc above 470 msec.
